Export: 17 November 2026, 23:15:01 UTC.
Quds selects the offered Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0
International option. The adapted German pack is distributed under that
same license: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Quds changes, 18 November 2026: visible German synonym groups and their
original group/term IDs are indexed and compressed into JSON. Per-term
usage levels/tags, group categories and typed relations are retained.
Reverse relations use the reverse labels expressly provided by the source.
Parenthetical material may be omitted or unwrapped for lookup-only aliases;
literal displayed terms remain unchanged. Source normalized_word columns
are not used because they fold umlauts and sharp-s. Invisible groups, other
languages and links to excluded records are not distributed in the pack.
The source word_mapping morphology table is not imported.

Additional German noun lookup reuses Quds existing qualified Unicode
Inflection-derived resource under Unicode-3.0. Its finite noun readings
preserve ambiguity; general verbs/adjectives and automatic reinflection
are not provided. Its original license and notice are included here.

Independent Quds implementation code remains MIT. This does not relicense
the OpenThesaurus data or remove its ShareAlike obligations. No additional
restrictions are imposed on covered data. See OPENTHESAURUS_COPYING.txt,
CC_BY_SA_4.0.txt and the Unicode notices in this directory.
